name: baseline-shipped
hypothesis: shipped causal 20-bar momentum baseline captures trend after 10:00 CT
outcome: zero passes all 14 years; MES pnl -273k MGC -559k over 3406 sessions; churn/fees dominate
mechanism: per-bar mean-cross momentum flips too fast; fees 81k+207k

name: on-drift-hold
hypothesis: hold MES+MNQ+M2K 17:00->09:00 CT long captures overnight equity drift; score>0 all 2020-23
outcome: gate passed (2020 .113, 2021 .009, 2022 .013, 2023 .009) but negative total pnl -530k: DLL intrabar locks on 741/1204 days flatten at adverse prices; M2K illiquid ON destroys -402k on fees/locks; MES -84k MNQ -45k
mechanism: adverse simultaneous-extreme valuation + no stop discipline = locks; overnight illiquidity (M2K) toxic

name: on-drift-stop
hypothesis: hard stop at 35% of 20-session ON range cuts left tail; lifts pass rates
outcome: gate fail: 2021 0.0, 2023 0.0; 2020 .18, 2022 .03, 2019 .035. total -124k, stops+fees eat drift; entries 6762 => churn worse than exp2 on MES (-102k vs -84k)
mechanism: stop too tight vs ON noise at entry hour; early-evening whipsaw exits before 00:00-08:30 accumulation leg

name: orb-30min
hypothesis: 30-min opening-range breakout on MES/MNQ/M2K, entries >=09:35 CT, stop opposite extreme, $300 risk
outcome: gate pass (2020 .061 2021 .017 2022 .144 2023 .031; 2019 0.0). total -18.7k; fees 16.3k. Gross: MNQ long +4852, short side +7930 in 2022 but -5150 in 2023; 2019 both sides negative. 2.8 entries/day
mechanism: ORB roughly breakeven gross, regime dependent; worst-3 years = 2019(.0) 2021(.017) 2023(.031)

name: last-half-hour-momentum
hypothesis: 14:30-15:00 CT return follows sign of prior close->14:29 return (Gao et al.) on MES/MNQ
outcome: gate fail 2021-2023 zero; net -11.6k, fees 10.9k; gross ~ -0.7k i.e. no edge
mechanism: effect absent/arbitraged in 2019-23 micro sample at 1-min with stressed costs

name: xasset-1h-orb-crash
hypothesis: first-hour (08:30-09:29) range breakout continuation across 12 markets/5 classes
outcome: CRASH: aggregate requested exposure 5.5 > 5 (ZN/ZT weight 1 x cap 5). No score.
mechanism: bug: per-symbol cap ignored evaluator weights; fix = per-symbol budget 5/N standard equivalents

name: xasset-1h-orb-crash2
hypothesis: same as exp6 with exposure budget split by symbols present in panel
outcome: CRASH: prefix causality failed MGC 2014 - cap depended on which symbols existed in truncated panel (micros start 2019)
mechanism: panel-composition dependence is a lookahead; fix = fixed denominator len(SPEC)

name: xasset-1h-orb
hypothesis: first-hour range breakout continuation across 9 micro markets (equity/metals/FX), fixed exposure budget
outcome: zero passes every year; net -3.0M. FX micros (M6E 37k entries, -1.25M) and MGC/SIL churn: held targets get flattened by evaluator at every missing minute then re-entered. Equity micros alone ~-80k net incl ~25k fees => negative gross
mechanism: illiquid micros have 20-170 missing minutes/day; strategy must abort on gap. 1h ORB has no gross edge on equity micros 2019-23

name: screen-orb30-gross-R
hypothesis: offline screen (own code, not evaluator): exp4 ORB30 rule gross R/trade per market, 2010-18 vs 2019-23, to find markets where breakout continuation beats stressed costs
outcome: gross R mostly 0.00-0.06 both periods; costs 0.03-0.8R. Only CL/RB/HO/GC/PL positive both periods but net ~0. FX strongly NEGATIVE pre-2019 (-0.13..-0.26R: breakouts fade) but ~0 in 2019-23 (decayed). Rates costs huge vs 1m ranges. Median $ risk of 1 full contract > $300 for ES/NQ/CL post-2019 => micros needed
mechanism: plain ORB has no robust gross edge; FX fade edge decayed

name: screen-daily-reversal
hypothesis: offline screen: fade prior RTH day return (A) or ON gap (B), hold 08:29->14:59, 1 contract, stressed costs
outcome: net negative nearly everywhere (ES -56 $/ctr/day, ZB -112); only NQ-A (+27, 6/14 yrs) and RTY-A marginal => no robust edge; gross ~0, stressed 2-tick slippage kills
mechanism: no daily reversal edge at RTH horizon net of stressed costs

name: screen-on-conditional
hypothesis: offline screen: ON leg (17:01 open -> 08:29 close) long after 5d/20d down move vs unconditional, 1 full contract, stressed costs
outcome: NQ uncond long +9.6 $/ctr net, NQ long-after-5d-down +28.5 (9/13 yrs>0); ES negative (cost 57.5 rt eats ~35 gross); YM/RTY ~0. Cost/vol ratio: NQ/MNQ cheapest (~0.5-0.7% of daily range) vs ES/CL ~2%
mechanism: ON drift real but thin (~0.5-1 NQ pt/night); only viable on most cost-efficient contract

name: screen-orb30-by-side
hypothesis: offline screen: split exp4/exp9 ORB30 gross R by side on ES/NQ
outcome: ES long +0.031R pre-2019 / +0.055R post; ES short -0.047 / -0.042 (both periods negative). NQ long -0.007 / +0.062, short -0.03 / +0.029. Long side consistently better => upside breakouts continue, downside breakouts fade
mechanism: equity risk premium drift + dip-buying / short-gamma dealer flows reverse downside breaks; long-only ORB economically motivated

name: orb30-long-only
hypothesis: long-only 30m ORB on MES/MNQ (screen exp12: downside breaks fade)
outcome: gate fail (2020/2021/2023 zero passes). net -1.2k vs exp4 -18.7k: MNQ +3.6k, MES -4.7k; fees 5.8k. Daily pnl variance too small to reach +3000 in 30 sessions: size cap 3 binds and ~1.1 trades/day
mechanism: score is a pass-rate on +3000/30d with -2000 trailing: needs daily sd ~400-600 with mean>=0 (own rule-structure MC: sd500 mu0 => ~21% pass, sd150 mu30 => ~1%). Edge alone insufficient; risk utilization matters

name: orb30-long-mnq-tightstop
hypothesis: MNQ only long ORB, stop 0.5x range, cap 20 to use full $300 risk => more variance
outcome: gate fail (only 2021 .039). net -1.35k, fees 5.7k, daily sd 237. Tight stop raises fee drag and stop-outs; gross ~ +4.3k over 5 yrs
mechanism: tighter stop inside 1-min noise converts edge to costs; variance still below needed ~400-500

name: orb30-mnq-both-fullrisk
hypothesis: MNQ only ORB30 both sides, stop opposite extreme, cap 20 so trades use full $300
outcome: zero passes; but net +510 (2021 +2.4k, 2022 +0.8k, 2023 +1.4k, 2019 -3.3k). 1.8 ctr/trade avg: $300 risk rule (not cap) binds; daily sd 164
mechanism: single-market $300-risk stream cannot reach +3000/30d; need several concurrent independent streams

name: orb30-5micro-gapabort
hypothesis: ORB30 both sides on MNQ MES MYM MCL MGC, cap 8, gap abort, more concurrent streams => variance
outcome: gate fail (2021, 2023 zero). net -5.3k; MNQ +4.1k, MES -4.6k. BUG: gap abort fired on ANY in-session gap incl. overnight, so MCL traded 19x, MGC 70x, MYM 172x
mechanism: abort must apply only while holding a position

name: orb30-5micro-gapfix
hypothesis: exp16 with gap-abort only while holding
outcome: 2019 .009 2020 .10 2021 .135 2022 .17 2023 .074 but score 0: MGC history from 2010 makes 2010-2018 eligible zero-pass years in worst-3. net -78k: MGC -45k (2467 entries, gaps), MES -17k, MYM -18k; MNQ +1k, MCL +1.6k. sd 523 => pass rates driven by variance not edge
mechanism: score counts every year with data; long-history losers zero the score. MES/MYM duplicate MNQ underlying with worse cost/vol

name: orb30-mnq-mcl
hypothesis: ORB30 both sides MNQ+MCL only (drop correlated MES/MYM, gappy MGC); post-2019 products only so pre-2019 years not eligible
mechanism: positive but thin edge; variance insufficient for +3000/30d

name: screen-rth-reversal-stop
hypothesis: offline screen: fade prior day, 09:31->14:55 with 1x avg-range stop, micro costs
outcome: negative 12/14 years in every market; NQ positive only 2020-21. Rejected
mechanism: no daily mean-reversion edge in RTH horizon

name: orb30-mnq-mcl-2tries
hypothesis: exp18 + allow 2nd ORB attempt after stop for more variance
outcome: net +3.4k, sd 252 (vs 233); 2019/2020 still zero => gate fail. 2023 flipped to -2.3k
mechanism: re-entry adds fees ~2.4k for little variance

name: orb30-equity-long-mcl
hypothesis: ORB30 1/day: MNQ MES MYM M2K long-only + MCL both sides, cap 8; more streams => variance
outcome: 2021 .143 2022 .166 2023 .135 but 2019/2020 zero => gate fail. sd 468, net -16.9k: 2019 -15.2k, 2020 -6.0k; MES -8.4k MYM -8.7k M2K -5.0k (correlated equity longs, higher cost/vol), MNQ +3.5k, MCL +1.8k
mechanism: variance now adequate; equity-long ORB stack loses in 2019-20 and the 4 equity streams are one bet. Only MNQ consistently positive

name: orb30-mnq-mcl-mhg
hypothesis: ORB30 both sides across 3 classes MNQ MCL MHG
outcome: MHG -7.6k (331 entries 2022-23) wipes 2023 => 2019/2020/2023 zero; MNQ/MCL unchanged vs exp18
mechanism: copper ORB breakouts fail (consistent with exp9 HG negative net)

name: orb30-exp4+mcl-gapabort
hypothesis: exp4 rule (cap 3) on MES MNQ M2K + MCL with gap-abort while holding
mechanism: pass rate largely from variance of 4 concurrent streams, not net edge; MNQ/MCL carry the only positive pnl

name: orb30-exp23-mes-longonly
hypothesis: exp23 with MES long-only (exp12 ES downside breaks fade both periods)
outcome: net improves -14.6k -> -8.5k (MES -9.0k -> -4.2k) but 2020 pass rate .061 -> 0 => gate fail. sd 356
mechanism: lower variance cost more passes than the pnl gain; confirms score is variance-sensitive and pass counts are noisy at this edge level

name: orb30-mes-mnq-mcl
hypothesis: exp23 minus M2K (illiquid, worst cost/vol)
outcome: gate pass but score drops .026 -> .0087 (2020 .017, 2023 .009); net improves -14.6k -> -4.6k. sd 345
mechanism: again: removing a losing stream raises pnl but lowers variance and pass count. Score rewards variance at ~zero edge; treat dev scores at this level as noise-dominated

name: orb30-expansion-gate
hypothesis: exp23 + trade only when 30m range >= 1.2x trailing 20-session median range (vol expansion = informed flow)
outcome: net improves -14.6k -> -4.9k (MNQ +1.8k, MCL +1.0k, MES -2.4k, M2K -4.3k), entries 1003 vs 3653, but sd 427 -> 166 => zero passes all years
mechanism: filter removes noise trades (economics better) and variance (score worse). Confirms dev score at this edge level is a variance measure, not an edge measure

name: orb30-expansion-cap8
hypothesis: exp26 with cap 8 to use full $300 risk per trade
outcome: size barely changed (contracts 1234 vs 1003; $300/(range*PV) already >=3), sd 171, zero passes
mechanism: variance is frequency-limited (~0.8 trades/day), not size-limited

name: orb30-6micros
hypothesis: exp23 rule on 6 post-2019 micros (add MYM MHG) for more concurrent streams/variance
mechanism: extra streams add variance but negative edge; 2023 losses from MYM/MHG kill the gate
